items.title: Mike Evans: Officially DNP on Wednesday
items.body_text: Evans (ribs/Achilles) officially didn't practice Wednesday, Harrison Rich of the San Francisco Chronicle reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Brock Bowers: Logs limited practice Wednesday
items.body_text: Bowers (hamstring/calf) was a limited participant in Wednesday's practice, Around The NFL reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Jaylen Waddle: Tending to chest injury
items.body_text: Waddle was limited at Wednesday's practice due to a chest injury, Aric DiLalla of the Broncos' official site reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Travis Kelce: Limited Wednesday
items.body_text: Kelce (ankle) was a limited practice participant Wednesday, Matt Derrick of ChiefsDigest.com reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Zach Charbonnet: Logs full practice Wednesday
items.body_text: Charbonnet (knee) was a full participant at Wednesday's practice, Corbin K. Smith of EmeraldCitySpectrum.com reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
